node.label: Christophe Charle
node.date_label: Les Élites de la République (1987) · Naissance des « intellectuels » (1990) · Histoire sociale de la France au XIXe siècle (1991)
node.description: A historian of elites, intellectuals and comparative European social history. In his written exchange with Michel Pinault he argues that social history should cross political, economic and cultural questions rather than become an enclosed specialty. His account of intellectual history connects cultural and political positions with the social worlds in which ideas circulate, are received and become resources for action. The entry presents those methodological choices from his own testimony, while keeping his selected books and their revised translations bibliographically distinct.
